title: RPG MV - Steam Achievements - Failed to Initialize and Bad Arguments

posts.author: RainingLamppost
posts.body:
Issue Summary:
Trying to get an RPG Maker MV game to work with Steam Achievements, been trying for a week straight
Details:
I'm using these as recommended and linked by KillerGin's guide (linked below):
NW: 0.49.2
STEAM SDK: 1.50
Greenworks Nodes: 0.49.2
Orange - Greenworks: Version: 1.2
Greenworks.js: greenworks-v0.14.0-nw-v0.33.3
So funnily enough, I had it almost working - achievements didn't fire and I'd get bad Argument but it said my Steam name in console at least
Before posting here I thought I should make absolutely sure I'd done all the steps (mostly from KillerGin though I've tried all of them before) - and now it's somehow broken itself a little further back with a "Failed to initialize" and I can't get it back to where it was after a couple more hours of trying things
More details:
The game has been accepted by Steam so it's public (set to Coming Soon)
I've been testing it by uploading the entire thing over and over again to Steam as well as from the editor - both of which used to connect to Steam and show my username in console but achievement thing would always be a Bad Argument when using:
OrangeGreenworks.activateAchievement('NEW_ACHIEVEMENT_1_1');
Folder structure:
Frankly I've been trying this for so long and so intensely I can't quite remember everything I've been doing but I've been following all advice I've seen as far as I know

Plugins I'm using:
Far too many but the game's been finished for a year and works (putting it on Steam now):
I've been trying to do this for a week and the game's coming out soon, if achievements can be made to work I still need to actually make them then have them tested to make sure this massive deck of cards of plugins isn't knocked over by Orange Greenworks somehow...
So where I am now is it says that Greenworks failed to initialize but even if that gets fixed, it'll no doubt go to the next step of "Bad argument" - I don't know js or much about the technical side of things so you may need to explain plainly
Thank you for reading, I hope we get can get this figured out once and for all and others after me with the same problem can have an easier time with it

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
your YEP plugins are in the INCORRECT order, so correct them first.
also Olivia_Horror Effect has a nasty bug which
require a patch
.
the patch is needed or your game lags over time if you use it.
but incorrect order of plugin can cause many errors.
so categorize it.

posts.author: utunnels

One thing to know: even if your setup is correct you can do achievement test from the editor because steam can't get your game id that way, it thinks you are playing MV.
So roll back to the step it says your steam user name and try to launch the game outside of the editor?
Also don't forget to put a steam_appid.txt with your game's id in the game's folder.
